meta.title: "Create New Version" appears only when the backend allows it
gaps: The catalog cannot read or compare config.can_create_new_version from GET /event_groups/:id; the prepared event is not guaranteed to have that flag set to true.
The fixed prepared state provides no second event with an approved award, so the required absence check on that event cannot be performed.
Checking the alternative option inside the version dropdown requires a dropdown control label that is not provided.
